transport: SSH file transfer after successful fresh-data collection
feature_transform: daily cross-sectional average-tie percentile within the annual pool

training.target: next24h price excess return versus available annual-pool equal-weight benchmark

signal_rule: only closed 4h bars and historically available market-cap observations
execution_rule: record actual signal-ready time; use subsequent observed executable quotes, never backfill midnight fills
holding_counts: match numpy.array_split deciles G10 and G1 in the benchmark
rebalance: daily equal notional within each side, including retained names
replacement: retain eligible incumbents within top/bottom30%; fill vacancies by score from top/bottom10%; trim weakest incumbents if count falls
accounting: compound daily net equity; record fees, quote spread and funding separately
stale_or_incomplete_input_action: skip decision and record reason; never fabricate factors or marks
